content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for AP High Court District Judge (Entry Level) Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Download the application form from the official website: https://aphc.gov.in. Fill the application form carefully with correct information. Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates. Check all details carefully before submission. Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed. Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 15-10-2026. Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by the High Court of Andhra Pradesh for filling up District Judge posts under direct recruitment for the year 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for AP High Court District Judge 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 10 vacancies available for the District Judge (Entry Level) position under this notification.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to submit the offline application?
faq.answer: The last date for the receipt of filled offline application forms is 15-10-2026. Candidates must ensure it reaches on time.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification required for this post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Law Degree along with not less than 7 years of practice as an Advocate or equivalent Judicial service experience.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for AP High Court District Judge Recruitment?
faq.answer: The candidate's minimum age should be 35 years and maximum age should be 45 years, with age relaxations applicable for reserved categories.

faq.question: Q6. How can I apply for this job?
faq.answer: Interested candidates need to download the application pro forma from the official website, fill it out, attach necessary documents, and send it offline via post.

faq.question: Q7. What is the application fee for OC/BC/EWS candidates?
faq.answer: The application fee for OC, BC, and EWS category candidates is Rs. 1500/-, payable as per the official instructions.

faq.question: Q8. What is the salary offered for District Judge (Entry Level)?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive a handsome salary ranging from Rs. 144840 to Rs. 194660 per month as per judicial pay scales.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for AP High Court District Judge?
faq.answer: The selection process comprises a Computer Based Screening Test, a Main Written Examination, and a final Viva Voce interview.

faq.question: Q10. Where should I send the completed offline application form?
faq.answer: The application form along with a crossed Demand Draft and testimonials must be sent to the Registrar (Recruitment), High Court of Andhra Pradesh, Nelapadu, Amaravati, Guntur District, PIN - 522 239.
